scope: Static website imagery; excludes generated course/lesson media, user uploads, and course thumbnails.
visualDirection: Flat editorial vector books and a compact book-and-leaf mark, retaining the page’s cream, apricot, sage, lavender, and butter palette. Solid fills, clean curves, restrained outlines; no photorealistic textures or lighting.
contentPlan: Keep the current home-page copy, creation actions, workflow, and library; replace the decorative hero artwork and shared brand mark.
interactionPlan: Retain the existing hero entrance, navigation hover/focus states, and reduced-motion behavior.

review.finding: Generic thin outline; weak silhouette at favicon sizes.
review.action: Replaced both consumers with brand-mark.svg, a filled open book and growing leaf in a charcoal tile.

review.finding: The original geometric stack could use clearer covers and pages; the photographic replacement did not match the flat page styling.
review.action: Replaced with a hand-authored SVG: an open butter-colored book, layered cream pages, sage and lavender closed books, a peach ribbon, and small accents matching the existing icon language.

review.finding: Clear small utility icon used in loading and guide/setup surfaces.
review.action: Kept as vector; raster imagery would reduce small-size legibility.

review.finding: Previews communicate five distinct styles and match the underlying animator references.
review.action: Kept to preserve the relationship between preview and resulting video style.

review.finding: Course/lesson examples and fallbacks, outside this change's scope.

review.asset: Profile images and generated course/lesson media

logo.format: Hand-authored SVG, 32 × 32; reused by header and favicon.

heroAsset.format: Hand-authored SVG, viewBox 0 0 480 320; solid vector paths only.
heroAsset.design: Curved open pages, isometric closed books, a peach backdrop and ribbon, restrained charcoal linework. No gradients, filters, embedded raster images, or external dependencies.
heroAsset.delivery: A single scalable file replaces both WebP sizes. Explicit intrinsic dimensions preserve the existing 3:2 layout.

validation.browser: SVG inspected in the existing home-page composition; layout and responsive CSS unchanged.
validation.asset: XML parses; only svg/title/g/path/circle elements; no external references or raster data.
validation.build: npm run build passed, including TypeScript, frontend boundaries, and answer prompt checks.
